rows.Kwic: 何謂綿密？眉毛與虗空廝結，針劄不入，水洒不濕，不容有毫𨤲間隙。

Override.AttributionNote: Boshan Chan Admonitions (博山禪警語): in his admonitions to beginners, Wuyi Yuanlai asks what close-woven means and defines it as permitting no hairbreadth gap.
